initialExam.title: Indian Navy AA (Artificer Apprentice) 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Agniveer SSR/AA in the Indian Navy for technical maintenance of naval equipment. Notification Mar 2026; exam held 13 May 2026. Result awaited.
initialExam.qualifications: 10+2 (PCM) with minimum 60% marks from a recognized Board
initialExam.syllabus: English (Comprehension, Grammar, Vocabulary, Verbal Ability), Science (Physics - Mechanics, Heat, Optics, Electricity; Chemistry - Organic, Inorganic, Physical), Mathematics (Algebra, Trigonometry, Calculus, Coordinate Geometry, Probability, Statistics, Mensuration), General Knowledge (Current Affairs, Geography, History, Polity, Sports, Defence, Science & Technology).
initialExam.examPattern: Written Exam: English + Science + Maths + GK - 200 marks, 60 minutes. Qualifying marks in each section. Physical Fitness Test (PFT) after written exam.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Examination → Physical Fitness Test (PFT) → Medical Examination → Merit-based Selection → INS Chilka Training
initialExam.perks: Military Service Pay (MSP), DA, Kit Maintenance Allowance, Ration, Free Medical, Canteen, Subsidized Housing, Leave Travel Concession
initialExam.careerGrowth: Artificer Apprentice → Leading Seaman → Petty Officer → Chief Petty Officer → Master Chief Petty Officer (can also become Commissioned Officer through CW scheme).
initialExam.jobRole: Maintenance and repair of naval weapons, sensors, electronics, and propulsion systems aboard warships and naval establishments.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindiannavy.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill application with educational & personal details 4. Upload photo & signature 5. Submit (No fee required)
